name: Wire (WireDrupal)
description: A Livewire-style 'HTML over the wire' framework for Drupal — build dynamic, server-rendered reactive UI components without writing much JavaScript. A developer framework distributed via Packagist (wire-drupal/wire); pulled here as a dependency of musaed.
project_description:
Component approach to build dynamic interfaces for Drupal.

 This is the port of the popular Livewire package from Laravel ecosystem.

 See the Documentation and hope you'll like it as much as me.

 For now, the development will occur on Github 

 composer require wire-drupal/wire 

 Ecosystem 
 - Livewire Field - provides a custom field type that allows content entities to reference Wire component plugins.
